state.instructions: These are tasting notes written by a sommelier. Judge the wine described, not the writing.
state.note: Ripe blackberry and cassis lead, framed by toasty oak and firm, fine-grained tannins. Long, layered finish with graphite and dried herbs. Impressive now; will reward a decade in the cellar.

quality.instructions: How good is the wine in `note`, for its `price_eur`, read as `instructions` says?
criteria: Faulty or unpleasant - the note is mostly criticism
Barely acceptable - drinkable, nothing to recommend it
Simple and sound - correct, plain, forgettable
Pleasant everyday wine - some appeal, little depth
Good - clear varietal character, well made
Very good - balanced, with something to say
Outstanding - depth and length, built to age
Superb - among the best of its type
Profound - the note treats it as exceptional

ageing.instructions: Does `note` say the wine will improve with age?
